interface.longDescription: An experimental source-only control architecture derived from v6.3.1. Preserves authenticated receipts, ProjectionDefectGraph v3, 256x8 world materialization, GPU parity surfaces, bounded media candidates, and durable-replay source paths. Adds controlled JA/EN grammar, same-artifact IR/TL/completion, separate Cargo observations, externally authorized file repair, signed checkpoint heads and fresh resume, structural distillation and explicit consumer views. Independent semantic evaluation, general performance, real host pickup and host-wide enforcement are not established.
